usage: `foliage.CullAll=<值>` / `foliage.CullAll <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If greater than zero, everything is considered culled.

usage: `foliage.CullDistanceScale=<值>` / `foliage.CullDistanceScale <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls the cull distance scale. Foliage must opt-in to cull distance scaling through the foliage type.

usage: `foliage.DebugBuildTreeAsyncDelayInSeconds=<值>` / `foliage.DebugBuildTreeAsyncDelayInSeconds <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Adds a delay (in seconds) to BuildTreeAsync tasks for debugging

usage: `foliage.DensityScale=<值>` / `foliage.DensityScale <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls the amount of foliage to render. Foliage must opt-in to density scaling through the foliage type.

usage: `foliage.DisableCull=<值>` / `foliage.DisableCull <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If greater than zero, no culling occurs based on frustum.

usage: `foliage.DitheredLOD=<值>` / `foliage.DitheredLOD <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If greater than zero, dithered LOD is used, otherwise popping LOD is used.

usage: `foliage.ForceLOD=<值>` / `foliage.ForceLOD <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If greater than or equal to zero, forces the foliage LOD to that level.

usage: `foliage.Freeze`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Useful for debugging. Freezes the foliage culling and LOD.

usage: `foliage.InstanceRuns=<值>` / `foliage.InstanceRuns <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to use the InstanceRuns feature of FMeshBatch to compress foliage draw call data sent to the renderer.  Not supported by the Mesh Draw Command pipeline.

usage: `foliage.LODDistanceScale=<值>` / `foliage.LODDistanceScale <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Scale factor for the distance used in computing LOD for foliage.

usage: `foliage.LogFoliageFrame`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Useful for debugging. Logs all foliage rendered in a frame.

usage: `foliage.MaxEndCullDistance=<值>` / `foliage.MaxEndCullDistance <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Max distance for end culling (0 disabled).

usage: `foliage.MaxOcclusionQueriesPerComponent=<值>` / `foliage.MaxOcclusionQueriesPerComponent <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls the granularity of occlusion culling. 16-128 is a reasonable range.

usage: `foliage.MaxTrianglesToRender=<值>` / `foliage.MaxTrianglesToRender <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: This is an absolute limit on the number of foliage triangles to render in one traversal. This is used to prevent a silly LOD parameter mistake from causing the OS to kill the GPU.

usage: `foliage.MinimumScreenSize=<值>` / `foliage.MinimumScreenSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: This controls the screen size at which we cull foliage instances entirely.

usage: `foliage.MinInstancesPerOcclusionQuery=<值>` / `foliage.MinInstancesPerOcclusionQuery <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls the granualrity of occlusion culling. 1024 to 65536 is a reasonable range. This is not exact, actual minimum might be off by a factor of two.

usage: `foliage.MinLOD=<值>` / `foliage.MinLOD <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Used to discard the top LODs for performance evaluation. -1: Disable all effects of this cvar.

usage: `foliage.MinOcclusionQueriesPerComponent=<值>` / `foliage.MinOcclusionQueriesPerComponent <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Controls the granularity of occlusion culling. 2 should be the Min.

usage: `foliage.OffGroundThreshold=<值>` / `foliage.OffGroundThreshold <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Maximum distance from base component (in local space) at which instance is still considered as valid

usage: `foliage.OnlyLOD=<值>` / `foliage.OnlyLOD <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If greater than or equal to zero, only renders the foliage LOD at that level.

usage: `foliage.OverestimateLOD=<值>` / `foliage.OverestimateLOD <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If greater than zero and dithered LOD is not used, then we use an overestimate of LOD instead of an underestimate.

usage: `foliage.RandomLODRange=<值>` / `foliage.RandomLODRange <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Random distance added to each instance distance to compute LOD.

usage: `foliage.RebuildFoliageTrees`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Rebuild the trees for non-grass foliage.

usage: `foliage.SplitFactor=<值>` / `foliage.SplitFactor <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: This controls the branching factor of the foliage tree.

usage: `foliage.Test`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Useful for debugging.

usage: `foliage.ToggleVectorCull`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Useful for debugging. Toggles the optimized cull.

usage: `foliage.UnFreeze`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Useful for debugging. Freezes the foliage culling and LOD.

usage: `Landscape.DebugViewMode=<值>` / `Landscape.DebugViewMode <值>` 或 INI 中配置

usage: `landscape.DumpLODs`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
